_comment: The per-waking dialogue seam's fixture: stage 3 (or perk-eligible stage) ALREADY reached for Erin (erin_friend_of_the_inn), Relc (relc_brother_in_arms), AND Selys (selys_past_the_counter, added by issue #32's board-pick-REPEATABLE ruling -- a THIRD once_per_waking consumer), entity_first_use empty (no once_per_waking gate used yet this waking) -- the FIXTURE-FIRST policy precedent (krshia_stage3_pre) applied to all three NPCs this seam now ships. Positioned at the inn, adjacent to Erin (7,2) facing up, so the FIRST interact step opens her REAL hub directly (social_talked already carries {erin:true, relc:true, selys:true}, mirroring krshia_stage3_pre's same trick -- a fresh waking would otherwise consume a talk_pool line first). Erin's hub option count is pinned to exactly 4 visible entries: has_package/errand_decided hide the package-pickup row (hide_when); cleaned_the_inn+reported_cleaning TOGETHER hide BOTH cleaning-adjacent rows -- 'Let me deal with that table.' is a requires:{skill:...} option (VISIBLE-LOCKED, not progress-gated, so it shows regardless of basic_cleaning possession unless its OWN hide_when:cleaned_the_inn is met) and 'The table situation is handled.' only becomes visible once cleaned_the_inn is met, so it needs its own hide_when:reported_cleaning to clear in turn; gave_reward/kept_reward stay unmet (hides the epilogue rows). See stage3_perks_loop.json's own comments for the resulting visible-index math. Relc carries met_relc/sparred_with_relc/given_spear_by_relc (post-onboarding honest state, the spear gift already claimed so it doesn't add a 5th meet-hub row) plus cleared_the_warren and chatted_with_relc:3 for his own stage 3 -- none of Relc's meet-hub options use the requires:{skill/class} shape, so no equivalent extra row there. Selys carries errand_decided:1 (shared with Erin/package_delivered:1, the internally-consistent completion of the_errand quest chain both graphs read) and chatted_with_selys:2, her own stage-2 threshold, pinned exactly so 'Anything on the board worth my time?' is visible with once_per_waking unused; package_delivered:1 (new field, alongside the pre-existing has_package:1) closes out Selys's OWN 'Package for you, from Erin.'/'About that reward...' rows so her hub shows exactly the 5 entries stage3_perks_loop.json's comments assume, not a stray 6th package row -- has_package:1 alone (with package_delivered unset, the ORIGINAL fixture's latent state before this fixture change) never affected Erin's own hub gate (erin_errand.json never reads package_delivered), so this fix is additive-only. gold:0 so the wager's +1 and the board-pick's +5 are exact and unambiguous. TRAP: rng_state is a properly-derived state (.seed=1, captured .state = -1966449618399012673), never hand-typed -- WISave restores .state directly, not .seed. Every fight in this fixture's run is unaffected by rng_state choice.
